The public source update does not authorize a package, GitHub release, deployment, trusted-signature claim, independent-review claim, or production-readiness claim.
P4 release assurance remains blocked by signing, independent review, operational evidence, revocation, and production verification.
recommendation: The full bounded worktree is ready for one source-only commit and normal push to feat/agent-builder-latest, followed by a protected pull request to default main. Do not force-push or publish a release package.
